hypokalemia.definition: n. abnormally low level of potassium in the circulating blood leading to weakness and heart abnormalities; associated with adrenal tumors or starvation or taking diuretics
hypokalemia.translation:
n. 血钾过少, 低钾血症, 低钾血
[医] 血钾过少, 低钾血

hypokalemic.translation: [医]血钾过少, 低血钾, 降血钾药

hypokaliemia.translation: [医] 血钾量过少, 低钾血

hypokinemia.translation: 心输出量过少, 心排血量过少

hypokinesia.translation:
n. [医]运动功能减退
n. [医]运动功能减退
